value: flowering depends on photoperiod: only 2 of 36 plants flowered under 12 h, none under 16 or 10 h within 8 weeks, but all plants flowered after at least 4 weeks of an 8 h photo- and thermoperiod at high photon flux density
method: plants grown under a range of photoperiods (16, 12 and 10 h, and an 8 h photo- and thermoperiod) with temperature and photon flux density also varied, scored for flowering
conditions: the abstract reports no flowers under 16 or 10 h for up to 8 weeks; all plants flowered after at least 4 weeks of an 8 h photo- and thermoperiod at high photon flux density; low photon flux density reduced flowering; temperature had no apparent effect on the number of plants flowering

method: seedlings grown shaded and unshaded, with shading at 30% of full daylight for 9 months (autumn-spring) and intense shading below 8% of daylight
